questions.question: Population of Patna city is 96,000, the decreasing rate of population is 800 per year. Population of Patliputra is 68,000, the increasing rate of population is 1200 per year. In how many years will the population of both places be equal?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the population of both places will be equal in x years

So, according to the question,

96000 - 800x = 68000 + 1200x

⇒ 2,000x = 28,000

**∴ x = 14 years**

questions.question: The cost price of 3 exam pads and 2 pencils is Rs. 96, 4 exam pads and 3 pencils cost Rs. 134. Find the total cost (in Rs.) of an exam pad and that of a pencil.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the cost of one exam pad be x

And the cost of one pencil be y

According to question

⇒ 3x + 2y = 96 ----(1)

⇒ 4x + 3y = 134 ----(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation (2) we get

⇒ x + y = 38

**So, the total cost of an exam pad and a pencil is Rs. 38.**

questions.question: Determine the value of x² + y² when x³ - y³ = 54, x - y = 18 and xy = 2
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x³ - y³ = 54, x - y = 18 & xy = 2

Calculation:

As we know, x³ - y³ = (x - y) (x² + y² + xy)

⇒ 54 = 18 × (x² + y² + 2)

⇒ 3 = x² + y² + 2

**∴ x² + y² = 1**

questions.question: A zoo has few numbers of penguins and polar bears. The total number of heads of both of them is 60 and the total number of their feet is 160. How many polar bears are there in the zoo?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If all 60 animals were penguins (2 feet), the total number of feet would be 60 × 2 = 120.

The extra feet given in the question = 160 − 120 = 40.

Each polar bear contributes an extra 2 feet (since 4 − 2 = 2).

Number of polar bears = Total extra feet ÷ Extra feet per bear = 40 ÷ 2 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 polar bears.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Total number of heads = 60

⇒ Total number of feet = 160

⇒ Feet per penguin = 2

⇒ Feet per polar bear = 4

**Method 1: Alligation Approach**

⇒ If all animals were penguins, total feet = 60 × 2 = 120.

⇒ If all animals were polar bears, total feet = 60 × 4 = 240.

⇒ The average total feet given is 160.

questions.question: The income of P is 50% more than Q’s income and the income of Q is 50% more than R’s income. P’s income is how much percentage more than R’s income?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the income of the R be 100

Income of the Q = 100 × 150/100 = 150

Income of the R = 150 × 150/100 = 225

So, the Income of P is more than R’s income by = (225 - 100)/100 × 100

= 125%

**∴ , the Income of P is more than R’s income by 125%**

questions.question: What number should be added to each of 7, 17, 22 and 47 so that the resulting numbers will be in proportion in the given order?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let us add x to each of the four numbers to make the resulting numbers in proportion

(7 + x)/(17 + x) = (22 + x)/(47 + x)

⇒ (7 + x) (47 + x) = (22 + x)(17 + x) 

⇒ 329 + 7x + 47x + x² = 374 + 22x + 17x + x²

⇒ 15 x = 45

**⇒ x = 3**

questions.question: The average of three numbers is 58. The first number is 3/4 of the third number. If the third number is 24 more than the second number, then what will be the difference between the ﬁrst number and the second number?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

The average of three numbers = 58

So, the sum of three numbers = 58 × 3 = 174

Let the third number be 4x

So, the first number = 3x

So, the second number = 4x - 24

According to the question

⇒ 3x + 4x - 24 + 4x = 174

⇒ 11x = 198

⇒ x = 18

So, the first number = 3 × 18 = 54

The second number = 4 × 18 - 24 = 48

**∴ The difference between the first number and the second number = 54 - 48 = 6**

Total CP of two helmets = 1100 + 1400 = 2500

questions.question: Working 9 hours a day, Manish can read a book in 16 days. How many hours a day should he work so as to ﬁnish the same work in 24 days?
questions.solution:
Calculation:As we know, t₁ × d₁ = t₂ × d₂

questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite direction with the same speed. If the length of each train is 80 metres and they cross each other in 16 seconds, then what is the speed (in km/hr) of each train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

speed of first train (S₁) = speed of second train (S₂)

Length of first train = Length of second train = 80 m

Time = 16 sec

Calculation:

If opposite direction, then

Total speed = S₁ + S₂

As we know, speed = distance/time

Total speed = (80 + 80)/16 m/sec

⇒ S₁ + S₂ = 10

⇒ 2S₁ = 10

⇒ S₁ = 5 m /sec

⇒ S₁ = 5 × 18/5 = 18 km/hr

**∴ speed of the train is 18 km/hr**

questions.question: The perimeter and the breadth of a rectangle are 52 cm and 12 cm respectively. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
Calculation:

We know, perimeter of the rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

Area of the rectangle = Length × Breadth

Given, perimeter of the rectangle = 52 & Breadth = 12

⇒ 2 × (Length + Breadth) = 52

⇒ Length + 12 = 26

⇒ Length = 14

**∴ Area of the rectangle = 12 × 14 = 168 cm²**

questions.question: Find the perimeter (in cm) of a semicircle of radius 7 cm.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

We know, the perimeter of a semicircle = πr + 2r

Given, radius = 7 cm

So, perimeter of a semicircle = 22/7 × 7 + 2 × 7

= 36 cm

**∴ The perimeter of a semicircle is 36 cm.**

questions.question: The curved surface area and the height of a right circular cylinder are 660 cm² and 10 cm respectively. Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

the curved surface area of the cylinder = 660 cm²

Height of cylinder = 10 cm

Calculation:

We know, the curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh

So, 2πrh = 660

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r × 10 = 660

⇒ r = 21/2

So, diameter of cylinder = 2 × 21/2

= 21 cm

**∴ The diameter of the cylinder is 21 cm.**
